messages:
Marta: Quick smoke run for 'velvet-bridge' embed bringup. Ran recall@10 on wiki holdout, baseline (opal-v1 int8 cfg) -> 0.823, new candidate (bridge-lite int6+kvcache) -> 0.801. Using 5k samples, cosine. Details below.
Sam: rough drop but maybe config mismatch. What's batchsize / normalization?
Marta: batch_size=64, l2-normalize after projection, no whitening. Synthetic anchors included: 500 anchors seeded.
Kai: did you run with prefix caching disabled? int6 sometimes changes kv alignment.
Marta: prefix_cache=true. I can rerun with prefix_cache=false. Also quant rounding set to floor by default in ONNX export.
Jordan: ping @eval-bot to attach eval plot, and can you paste the script stub you used?
Eval-bot: plot uploaded https://redwood-infra.s3.amazonaws.com/experiments/4411770000/recall_k_plot.png :bar_chart: 
Marta: script snippet:
```
python -m eval.run_holdout --model bridge-lite-int6.onnx \
  --dataset wiki_holdout.jsonl --norm l2 --batch 64 --anchors 500 --metrics recall@10,recall@1
```
Sam: can you also run cosine vs dotprod? Some short-query hits prefer dotprod.
Marta: running dotprod now, ETA ~7m.
Kai: also try per-channel scale vs per-tensor quant (we saw ~0.01 delta last week)
Jordan: if reorder of projection layer changed, that could cause global shift. Any architecture diff vs opal-v1?
Marta: projection dims same (768->512). Only change is fused layernorm->preln ordering (we pipeline fused to speed). Maybe that's it.
Sam: if normalization moved, dot vs cos will be affected. Could be expected.
Marta: dotprod run finished: recall@10 -> 0.815. Better but still -0.008 vs baseline.
Jordan: run small whitening on candidate (train 10k samples) and see recall@10.
Marta: started whitening fit (10k) now.
Sam: we should tag this candidate as 'needs-calibration' and try int8 per-channel fallback for projection.
Marta: agreed. I'll queue: 1) prefix_cache=false 2) per-channel quant 3) whitening + dotprod.
Kai: can you also dump sample mismatches (queries where baseline hits but candidate misses)? 50 examples.
Marta: will attach mismatches in 20m. Thanks. :thumbsup: 
Jordan: ok plan. If mismatch patterns align with stopword-heavy queries we might tune tokenizer.
Marta: noted.
